description_sq:
Apartament per shitje 2+1+2 tek Selvia ,prane Qendres .
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8-te ne nje ndertim te ri me 2 ashensor te mire-administruar,me pamje paronamike te tiranes .
Apartamneti organizohet nga salloni se bashku me kuzhinen, nje korridor i cili ben shperndarjen e 2 dhomave te gjumit,ku njera me tualet ,1 tualet dhe 1 ballkon.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar si ne foto , ka nje siperfaqe totalet 91 m2.
description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2 in Selvia, near the Center. The apartment is located on the 8th floor in a new building with 2 well-maintained elevators, with a panoramic view of Tirana. The apartment is organized by the living room together with the kitchen, a corridor that divides the 2 bedrooms, one with a bathroom, 1 toilet and 1 balcony. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo, it has a total area of ​​91 m2.
